evidence.excerpt: Returns. Last holiday season. Buy online, return in store.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: the rep
evidence.note: Trigger of the evaluation: holiday returns problem.

evidence.excerpt: The store couldn't see the online order, so staff were refunding to gift cards or telling people to mail it back.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: the rep
evidence.note: Concrete failure: store could not see online orders.

evidence.note: Loyalty program failed due to split customer records.

evidence.label: fact

contradictions.what: Rep first named CTO Raj as final decider and sole contact, then said Angela signed with Adyen.
Rep said Angela signed, yet hedged 'Probably Angela' on who made the call.
Rep says we were ahead and won web side, yet knew it was lost at the workshop; ahead per Raj only.
Rep claimed Raj was contact 'the whole way', but the real decider Angela was met only once.
Online checkout demo loved by ecommerce lead, yet customer questions shifted almost entirely to stores.

dodges.question: Who made the final call, and how do you know?
dodges.what: Named Raj confidently on role and contact, without evidence of decision; later revealed Angela signed.

dodges.question: What did you say? (when Bev asked how a return works)
dodges.what: Answered tersely 'I described it', avoiding admitting no demo or substance was given.
